# South Africa OpenSourceRail Campaign
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

National outreach package covering **5 catalogued cities**. Values
below aggregate city screening models; the national brief separately treats the
shared manufacturing plant.

## Audience

- South Africa ministry responsible for transport and urban mobility
- South Africa national climate, energy or Green Climate Fund authority
- South Africa public investment, planning or finance authority
- Embassy or High Commission of South Africa in the United Kingdom — economic section

## National proposition

| Measure | Catalogue result |
|---|---:|
| Population represented | 6,200,000 |
| Lines / route length | 21 / 631 km |
| Fleet | 1,096 trainsets |
| City programme CAPEX | $6.34 B |
| Local capital and value allocation | $4.71 B (74%) |
| Station/depot PV / storage | 85.3 MW / 483.5 MWh |
| Illustrative external-capital saving | $9.78 B |

Lead with a government-reviewed pilot, local manufacturing and construction,
open standards, renewable-energy integration and independently checked demand,
environmental, social and engineering studies.
